title: The Comeback & The Breaking Point
summary: Taking a personal day from work, CPI alumna Megan Brooks drives Jordan back to campus for his triumphant ENG 102 advocacy presentation in Walton Hall on fixing the university's broken disability access map. Moments later in the parked car, however, the heartbreak of having to leave campus after just fifty minutes of normalcy triggers a violent autistic meltdown that threatens to pop Jordan's sternal wires—until Megan climbs across the center console, straddles his lap to pin his lower body without touching his chest, and grounds him with her bare hands, forging an unbreakable bond as his newest Safe Person.
